scientific_integrity: All asymptotic conclusions follow from the stated urn representation and factorial-moment proof. The finite checker only validates exact identities in bounded carriers. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent labelled equivalence partitions, independent Bernoulli vertex marks, fixed real critical-window parameter and global nested-modal satisfaction only. No quantitative convergence rate or nonuniform-frame extension is proved.
title: A double-exponential Poisson window for nested possibility on random two-agent S5 frames
